```yaml
name: Deploy Call Kent Audio Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Wrangler CLI
        run: npm install -g wrangler

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}.cloudflareworkers.com/call-kent-audio-worker:${{ github.sha }} .

      - name: Log in to Cloudflare Container Registry
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}" | docker login ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}.cloudflareworkers.com -u ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }} --password-stdin

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: |
          docker push ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}.cloudflareworkers.com/call-kent-audio-worker:${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Create Cloudflare Queue (if not exists)
        run: |
          wrangler queue create ${{ secrets.CF_QUEUE_NAME }} --max-queue-size 1000 --max-queue-ttl 86400
        env:
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set worker environment variables
        run: |
          wrangler config set AUDIO_CONTAINER_IMAGE ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}.cloudflareworkers.com/call-kent-audio-worker:${{ github.sha }}
          wrangler config set AUDIO_QUEUE_NAME ${{ secrets.CF_QUEUE_NAME }}
        env:
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Publish Cloudflare Worker
        run: wrangler publish --env production
        env:
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
```
